summary: Busy school-zone road, no parking on this kerb, houses about 10m away.
reasons: Main road, no cars parked on this side
School zone beside a signalised junction

drivers.seclusion: Houses front the kerb at 9-11m along its length; no clear gap.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow footpath edge, no pull-in; cars park only on the opposite kerb.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with turning lanes and a school zone.
drivers.convention: Nobody parks on this side; not a parking kerb.

sun_shade: Mostly open to the sun; trees around the south end.
